audience: business teams using SuperPhone for consent-based customer texting

useCases.title: Review a customer conversation
useCases.text: List conversations and inspect a selected conversation and its messages.

useCases.title: Find a customer record
useCases.text: Find a contact by email or phone number and review its details and tags.

useCases.title: Maintain a customer segment
useCases.text: Add or remove tags on a selected contact. Tags may trigger automations configured in your SuperPhone account.

useCases.title: Send a requested reply
useCases.text: Review the contact and conversation, confirm consent and opt-out status, then send a requested text. This sends a real message from your connected number.
